_comment: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored, packaged into the .wgt). brokerUrl = the machine running tools/spotify-broker.js, preferably its mDNS name; brokerScan = the LAN prefix scanned on port 8899 when the name does not resolve and the cached IP is stale; appKey = app_key from .local/spotify/config.json; deviceId = Spotify Connect device id (broker /devices).
